description: Test suite for Bot management API endpoints in Mattermost, including creation, patching, retrieval, enabling/disabling, assigning, and converting bots to users.

methods.name: TestCreateBot
methods.description: Tests for creating bots with various permission and configuration scenarios.

methods.name: TestPatchBot
methods.description: Tests for patching existing bots, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: TestGetBot
methods.description: Tests for retrieving individual bots, including permission and deletion status handling.

methods.name: TestGetBots
methods.description: Tests for listing bots with pagination, filtering, and permission controls.

methods.name: TestDisableBot
methods.description: Tests for disabling bots, including permission checks and idempotency.

methods.name: TestEnableBot
methods.description: Tests for enabling previously disabled bots, with permission validation.

methods.name: TestAssignBot
methods.description: Tests for assigning bots to users, including permission checks and error conditions.

methods.name: TestConvertBotToUser
methods.description: Tests for converting bots into user accounts, including permission validation and error handling.
